does: Puts one bound object on one tile of the AI grid: finds or makes the tile's metadata, adds the object to it, counts it on the subgrid, then rebuilds the tile's object flags.

evidence.says: the caller of eoc::AiGrid::UpdateTileObjectFlags in every hit of the write watch on a tile's flags when a barrel was created and when a placed door was opened or closed (TestLevel_Tom); its own caller FUN_140fc53f0 runs per cell of eoc::AiGrid::ForEachBoxCell; decomp code read: it finds the tile as RemoveObjectFromTile does
